senses.gloss:
m. (-तः)
1 The name of a Muni or saint.
2 The clearing nut plant.
E.
कै to sound, अत Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum); one of the seeds of this plant being rubbed upon the inside of the water jars used in Bengal, occasions a precipitation of the earthy particles diffused through the water.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Which, (of many.)
E.
किम् and डतमच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A name of AGNI or fire; this word is perhaps a corruption: see कचमाल and खतमाल.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Which, (of two,) whether.
E.
किम् and डतरच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Confused, perplexed, disordered.
2 Timid, gentle.
m. (-रः)
A large kind of fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.)
E.
का a little or badly, and तर what crosses.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 How many.
2 How much.
E.
किम् what, and डति aff.

ind.
1 In any way, in some way.
2 For some time.
E.
कति how many, and चित् aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
What, how much.
E.
थुक् added to कति.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 How many.
2 A certain number, so many.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
What, how much.
E.
थक् added to कतिपयथ.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Of how many sorts.
2 Of various kinds.
E.
कति, and विध sort.

n. (-णं)
1 A fragrant grass.
2 A plant, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.)
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, तृण grass.

n. (-यं)
Wine or vinous spirit.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, and तोय water.

r. 1st cl. (कत्थते)
1 To praise or celebrate.
2 To flatter or coax.
3 To boast.

r. 10th cl. (कत्रयति)
To loosen, to slacken, to remove.

n. (-रं)
The shoulder, the shoulder blade.

f. (-ता)
Timidity, agitation.
E.
तल् added to कातर; also with त्व, कातरत्वं.

m. (-लः)
The name of a fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.)
E.
see कातर, र changed to ल.

m. (-यः)
1 A name of KĀTYĀYANA.
2 A pupil of the same.
E.
कात्यायन with फक् affix and the middle syllable dropped; also कात्यायनीय.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Produced from any bad triad.
E.
कत्त्रय, and ढकञ् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
The name of a saint; also कात्यायन.
E.
कत a proper name, and यञ् affix implying descent or lineage.

m. (-नः)
1 The name of a celebrated lawgiver and divine sage.
2 An appellation of VARARUCI a poet.
E.
कात्य, and फक् pleonastic affix.
f. (-नी)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 A middle-aged widow.
E.
ङीष् added to कात्यायन; the daughter of the saint KĀTYĀYANA, (DURGĀ,) or resembling the wife of a sage in dress and austerity, (the widow.)

m. (-यः)
A pupil of KĀTYĀYANA.
E.
कात्यायन, and फक् aff.
